# Gasses Gasses are a critical part of the station's operation. You may know them as the stuff you breathe, but they are also relevant in many other ways
## Oxygen
A common gas, used to breathe by everyone on the station.
Oxygen is an oxidizer, which means it supports combustion. It's needed for fires to burn and a lack of it will extinguish them.
## Nitrogen
An inert gas, used in part with oxygen to create a breathable atmosphere.
Nitrogen is very stable and comprises most of a standard breathable atmosphere.
## Carbon Dioxide
A waste gas produced by the human respiration process. A common byproduct of combustion.
## Smoke
A gas created by combusting fires.
Breathing it in over a certain threshold has a chance to cause [bold]smoke inhalation[/bold], which must be treated by breathing as much pure oxygen as possible.
## Steam
A common gas, produced by the burning of plasma and other processes.
## Plasma
A highly flammable gas that is used in many processes on the station.
Engineering uses this gas to fuel the [textlink="AME" link="AME"].
Burning it generates a lot of heat, as well as gas byproducts such as carbon dioxide and steam.
## Miasma
A gas produced by the decomposition of bodies.
